instructions: Complete the mandatory read flow in /AGENT_RULES.md before generating any UI
Read {component}.agent.json before writing markup; read {component}.md before styling
Use only props, variants and sizes declared in the component's .agent.json
Use semantic Tailwind tokens only; never a raw color value where a token exists
Choose the ui:* namespace unless the surface is explicitly AI-generated or agent-driven
For ai:* components, honor the experienceMetadata accountability obligations in the manifest
Do not add dependencies or build tooling
outputsExpected: React + TypeScript that compiles against the existing tsconfig paths
A component list naming every id used
A token compliance note for any styling decision
An explicit gap note when a requested component is absent from the index

steps: State that the component is not in the closed inventory
Name the closest indexed alternatives with their ids
Offer to compose the need from indexed parts
Never silently substitute or hand-roll the missing component
Prefer a full page over a modal when the workflow is multi-step
Prefer the more accessible of two equivalent options
State the assumption in the output rather than blocking
